title_en: A Ukrainian official bought a $29 million US mansion with aid money
title_uk: A Ukrainian official bought a $29 million US mansion with aid money

origin.origin_note_en: A cloned property-listing site registered nine days earlier carried the story first; the fabricated listing was then amplified by a Storm-1516 asset and reply networks.

confirmations.finding_en: Traced the listing to a domain registered days before publication and found no corresponding property record.

changelog.note_en: Added the September run across five markets.

label: Mansion bought with aid

debunk_argument.assertion: A Ukrainian official bought a $29 million mansion.
debunk_argument.refutation: No county record shows the sale, and the company named as buyer has never filed in that state.

debunk_argument.assertion: The purchase was funded with Western aid.
debunk_argument.refutation: There is no purchase to fund. The listing site was registered nine days before it published.

false_claim: A Ukrainian official bought a $29 million US mansion with aid money
canonical_debunk: No county record shows the sale, and the company named as the buyer has never filed in that state. The listing site was registered nine days before it published.
